title: Check: Reactions of Metals with Water and Acids (B)

questions.stem: How do you test for hydrogen gas?

options.text: A burning splint produces a squeaky pop
It turns damp litmus paper white

questions.explanation: The test for hydrogen gas is to hold a burning splint near the gas. If hydrogen is present, it burns with a characteristic squeaky pop sound. Limewater turning milky is the test for carbon dioxide, and relighting a glowing splint is the test for oxygen.
